summary: Client physics streaming: bookkeeping of a cluster's always-loaded physics (two HashMaps of ls::ClusterAlwaysLoadedPhysicsData, a uint32 map, a frame stamp, a per-frame ModifiedPair list and a pending-data array); used by phx::PhysXDisableSimulationSystem::ProcessChangedClusters and the cluster physics loader. On cluster entities of idle levels.
open_questions: Element size/members of ls::ClusterAlwaysLoadedPhysicsData and of ModifiedPair not established (macOS has DynamicArray<ClusterAlwaysLoadedPhysicsInitData> and <ClusterAlwaysLoadedPhysicsData>), hence raw value pointers.
Key types of the maps assumed EntityHandle.
Field names (Data, InitData, PendingData, Frame) are inferred placeholders.
